mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the 5-year moving average coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-period SMA by at least 25 bps in a single month
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative when the trigger occurs, or the 5-period SMA is not clearly exceeded.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +0.5% and persists for two consecutive months, it predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate future wage growth.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL month-on-month change > +0.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes with persistent negative core CPIAUCSL changes, the 60-day forward return is not statistically different from zero.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS (labor market additions) followed within one month by a decline in UNRATE (unemployment) signals labor market tightening, which precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 10% in a month and UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points in the following month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative or flat despite the defined labor signal, or the pattern repeats without subsequent return gain.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (residential construction) of at least 15% predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects weakening demand for capital goods and consumer durables.
failure_condition: Over 20 consecutive 5-day windows, no negative returns occur when HOUST declines by ≥15%, or the signal is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) by more than 8% in a single month, accompanied by a decline in RSAFS (retail sales), predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it indicates weakening business activity and consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-on-month change < -8% and RSAFS month-on-month change < -5% in the same month
regime_hint: Dual contraction in manufacturing and retail supply chains
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically different from zero when both proxies show the specified contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months in a labor market expansion regime, it predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower unemployment supports equity risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for three consecutive months and UNRATE trend is downward over the prior 6 months
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative or flat despite the defined unemployment regime signal.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in FEDFUNDS for two consecutive months without a compensating rise in CPIAUCSL predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects persistent monetary tightening without price inflation.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS month-on-month < -0.5% for two consecutive months and CPIAUCSL month-on-month > +0.2% for both months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant when the defined policy pattern occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-month surge in GDPC1 (GDP MoM) followed by a sustained monthly decline of at least 2% for two months predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals a loss of momentum in economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 month-on-month > +3% in one month and GDPC1 month-on-month < -2% for two consecutive months thereafter
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is not negative when the defined GDP momentum pattern occurs, or the pattern is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
